script_text: Stop! Libra, the stars are screaming at you right now. Meanwhile, Jupiter is blessing your 1st House with a trine, giving you a magnetic aura that draws people in. This celestial dance means your social circle is buzzing with energy. If you're single, your magnetic Jupiter energy will attract potential partners, but watch for impulsive Mars energy causing misunderstandings with new flames. If taken, communicate clearly to avoid unnecessary arguments. In your 10th House of Career, Saturn is pushing you to take charge of your professional image, and financial opportunities may arise through networking in your 11th House of Friends. Avoid making major decisions under the Mars square today, but expect an unexpected financial gift from a friend. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
